description: Election Commission - Elected as a member of the Ninth Parliament for the Electrol District No. 02 Gampaha to Mr. Ajith Kumara Mannapperuma
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy through the electoral process. It details the declaration of a new Member of Parliament (Mr. A.
